original_question: Consider a Poisson manifold M of even dimension such that it is symplectic on a dense set U ⊂ M . Assume that M is endowed with a toric action which is Hamiltonian on U . Is there an analog of Delzant theorem for the image of the moment map?
target_in_paper: Problem 6.7 in §6, “Poisson geometry and action-angle variables” (the same question is numbered Problem 5.5 in the arXiv v1 PDF). ([upcommons.upc.edu](https://upcommons.upc.edu/bitstreams/d858abf8-e232-45e3-a199-3adac6cf7893/download))
correct_elements: Your draft captures the intended target essentially verbatim: it has the same hypotheses (a Poisson manifold M of even dimension, symplectic on a dense subset U, with a toric action that is Hamiltonian on U) and asks exactly for an analogue of Delzant’s theorem for the image of the moment map. ([upcommons.upc.edu](https://upcommons.upc.edu/bitstreams/d858abf8-e232-45e3-a199-3adac6cf7893/download))
missing_details: To make it fully stand-alone, specify that the moment map under discussion is the one defined on the Hamiltonian locus U, since the action is assumed Hamiltonian only on U. ([upcommons.upc.edu](https://upcommons.upc.edu/bitstreams/d858abf8-e232-45e3-a199-3adac6cf7893/download))

The surrounding scope should be made explicit: the paper poses this as a global/singular extension problem for the affine structure on the image of the moment map, after discussing regular Poisson manifolds and realizability of affine-leaf foliations. ([upcommons.upc.edu](https://upcommons.upc.edu/bitstreams/d858abf8-e232-45e3-a199-3adac6cf7893/download))

The motivating special cases should be noted: the paper points to b-Poisson and b^m-Poisson settings as examples where the affine structure on the moment-map image is already understood well enough to motivate the question. ([upcommons.upc.edu](https://upcommons.upc.edu/bitstreams/d858abf8-e232-45e3-a199-3adac6cf7893/download))

Do not merge in the paper’s follow-up sentence about regular Poisson manifolds unless you intentionally want the broader adjacent question; the paper states that as a further extension, not as an equivalent reformulation of the main problem. ([upcommons.upc.edu](https://upcommons.upc.edu/bitstreams/d858abf8-e232-45e3-a199-3adac6cf7893/download))
refined_question: Let M be a smooth Poisson manifold of even dimension 2n, and let U⊂M be the dense subset on which the Poisson structure is symplectic. Suppose that M carries a toric action whose restriction to U is Hamiltonian, with moment map μ defined on U. Is there a Delzant-type theorem for the image μ(U) of this moment map?
justification: The draft is targeting the paper’s official Delzant-type open problem in the Poisson setting, not a neighboring question. The match is direct: the sentence in Problem 6.7/5.5 is the same question up to minor wording. The nearby context shows that the intended scope is the extension of the affine-structure picture on moment-map images from regular Poisson manifolds to singular Poisson manifolds, with b-Poisson and b^m-Poisson manifolds singled out as motivating examples where such structures are already understood. The additional sentence about regular Poisson manifolds is a separate further question, so I have kept the refined version narrowly focused on the first sentence only. ([upcommons.upc.edu](https://upcommons.upc.edu/bitstreams/d858abf8-e232-45e3-a199-3adac6cf7893/download))
